task: Section 7: fixed-point category formalization -- distinguish literal, up-to-isomorphism, conjugacy, categorical, dynamical, and self-similar fixed points, and correct a notational looseness in prior runs.
correction: Prior runs wrote 'Gamma(R)=R' for a fixed point. This is imprecise: Gamma, correctly formalized, is a map Rel_fin -> Rel_fin/~= (finite relations to their isomorphism classes), since the color-refinement quotient construction only pins down R up to a relabeling of its color classes. The correct statement, used consistently from this run forward, is Gamma(R) ~= R (isomorphic, not literally identical), with the identification made explicit rather than left implicit.

fixed_point_taxonomy.literal_fixed_point: Gamma(R) = R as bit-strings. NOT used anywhere in this project -- depends on an arbitrary vertex-labeling convention (representation, not ontology, per the explicit distinction maintained since UOC-C0-MINIMAL-SEED-CLOSURE-001 Section 26).
fixed_point_taxonomy.fixed_point_up_to_isomorphism: Gamma(R) ~= R. THE operative definition used throughout runs 13-15. Existence proven (F_N^derived_v2 nonempty at N=2,3,4); uniqueness disproven (family, not singleton).
fixed_point_taxonomy.conjugacy_fixed_point: Gamma(R) = P R P^{-1} for some specific permutation matrix P. Equivalent in content to 'up to isomorphism' for finite relations under permutation action -- not a distinct notion here, since the only automorphisms of Rel_fin relevant to this project ARE permutation conjugations. Not separately tracked.
fixed_point_taxonomy.categorical_fixed_point: An object R such that R is terminal/initial in some category built from the Gamma-construction. NOT ATTEMPTED this run -- would require first defining the category (objects = finite relations, morphisms = ?) and no canonical morphism structure beyond isomorphism was constructed or needed for any result obtained so far. Left OPEN, not fabricated.
fixed_point_taxonomy.dynamical_attractor: lim_{n->infinity} Gamma_1^n(R) for a SEQUENCE of one-shot applications. This is exactly Gamma_infty as constructed in UOC-C0-MINIMAL-SEED-CLOSURE-001 -- PROVEN idempotent, zero exceptions, all 3160+ classes tested through N=4.
fixed_point_taxonomy.self_similar_object: R such that R restricted to a substructure is isomorphic to R itself (a genuinely different notion from any fixed-point criterion above -- self-similarity is a STRUCTURAL property of R alone, not a statement about Gamma). NOT TESTED this run -- flagged as a distinct, unexplored question for a future run (Section 16's canonical-family search touches this but was not completed).

which_category_is_correct: Gamma-fixed-point-up-to-isomorphism (equivalently, dynamical attractor of Gamma_1 iteration) is the notion actually used and computed throughout this project. It is the mathematically correct formalization GIVEN that Gamma's natural codomain is Rel_fin/~=, not Rel_fin. No other notion in this taxonomy was shown necessary or was computed this run.
